notes.title: Symphorix Graduates from Early Access This Month with Full Release 1.0!
notes.notes:
[p align="start"]Greetings, Cores!
[p align="start"]It feels like just yesterday that we embarked on this incredible journey with you, launching Symphorix into Early Access. Our story is a unique one: a solo developer from a small village, working alongside passionate students to bring a dream to life.\[1] Your support, feedback, and belief in our music-driven, strategic survivorlike has been the crescendo to our development symphony. Today, we are beyond excited to announce that the next major update will be our full release! Symphorix Version 1.0 will be launching later this month, marking the end of our Early Access chapter and the beginning of a whole new movement.
[p align="start"]When we first launched, we promised to remain in Early Access for one to three months to gather your invaluable feedback and polish the experience. We are thrilled to say that, thanks to your input, we are graduating in just two months, having fulfilled the promises we set out to achieve. This is not the end of our journey, but rather, the start of an even more ambitious future for Symphorix. We are committed to at least another year of active development, with tons of exciting content already in the works.
From Early Access to Full Symphony: The 1.0 Overture[p align="start"]Version 1.0 is a massive leap forward, built on the foundation we laid together during Early Access. We've been hard at work implementing a host of new features, significant improvements, and crucial fixes to make the game a richer, more dynamic, and more rewarding experience.
[p align="start"]Here’s a detailed look at what you can expect in the full release:

New Features: A richer, more dynamic experience

Bosses by Merit (Per-Note Bosses): A complete overhaul of progression! You will now earn your way through the orchestral onslaught. Defeat enough enemies of a specific note to summon its boss. Vanquish the boss to unlock the next enemy type and its corresponding musical note. One note at a time, you will conquer the symphony.

Enemy Meters on the HUD: To complement the new boss system, 12 new meters have been added to your display. These trackers show your kill-count for each note, displaying statuses like "Boss Coming," "BOSS ALIVE," and "BOSS KILLED." The meter pulses with each kill and again when you damage the boss, with its intensity growing as you get closer to the showdown. While a boss is active, the meter reflects its real-time health.

Enemies Dance on Their Notes: Prepare for a visual feast! When a song hits the note an enemy represents, they will perform a quick, signature "dance," no matter how far away they are. It's a flashy, fast flourish that adds a new layer of life to the battlefield.

Epic Death Explosion: Your demise is no longer a simple fade to black. Now, dying triggers a spectacular cinematic explosion! A massive shockwave, a blinding flash, cascading sparks, and flying energy globes will fill the screen as your core disappears. We've even added a 1.5-second pause before the game over screen so you can fully appreciate the beautiful destruction.

Center-Screen Popups: Important notifications—such as new enemy introductions, level-ups, and upgrade confirmations—are now clearer and more organized. They appear in the center of the screen and stack upwards, ensuring you never miss a critical update.

Escape Key Shortcut: A quality-of-life improvement that allows you to press Escape to quickly deselect components and close panels when not in a game session, mirroring the functionality of a right-click.

Gameplay Improvements: Deeper Strategy, Smoother Flow

Smarter Orbital Enemies: Foes that circle you are now far more menacing. They will spiral inward, accelerating when far away and slowing their approach as they get closer, creating dynamic and tense encounters.

Healing Enemies Join the Fight: A new strategic challenge awaits. Some enemies can now project a healing beam onto a wounded ally, steadily restoring their health. The stronger the healer, the faster the heal.

Cannibal Enemies Evolve: A truly terrifying new enemy type can drain the health and power from other enemies, growing larger and more powerful with each "meal." The longer they survive, the greater the threat they become.

Boss Glow-Up: Bosses are now a single, formidable enemy that arrives at a significantly higher level than the current wave and is scaled up in size for a truly imposing presence.

Steady Pressure & Longer Climb: The enemy count now ramps up smoothly over the first 15 minutes of a run, providing a more consistent challenge. Furthermore, the difficulty for enemies and bosses can now scale up to level 100, ensuring the late-game remains spicy.

Progression Clarity: With the new boss system, only the meter for the currently active note will count your kills. Once its boss is defeated, the meter grays out, and the next note's enemies join the fray.

Fresh Song Discovery: The song list is now randomized every time you start the game, encouraging the discovery of new tracks. Your custom songs will still conveniently appear at the top.

Smoother Play Flow: We've removed the "Accept Costs" button before a run begins. The game now handles this automatically when you hit "Play," getting you into the action faster.

Clearer Announcements & Snappier Animations: Alerts for new enemy types are now easier to spot in the heat of battle, and a host of animation timings have been polished to ensure they are always snappy and responsive.

Fixed Issues

Silent Beam Effects: The new healing and cannibal beams now operate without sound, allowing you to focus on the core combat audio.

Enemies will no longer occasionally get stuck in a deformed state after their note animation.

Your wallet is now safe! Pasting a node's settings will no longer allow you to go into debt. The action will be blocked if you cannot afford the cost.
Still to Come in Version 1.0[p align="start"]We're putting the finishing touches on several key features that will also be included in the full release:

Achievements: Test your skills and unlock a full suite of achievements.

Leaderboards: Compete with players from around the world for the top spot.

Rating and Ranking Songs: A system to rate and rank the musical battlegrounds.

Unlocking / Progression System Improvements: Further refinements to the overall progression.

Onboarding / Tutorial: An improved introduction to the game's unique mechanics.

Energy Stealer: A surprise that we can't wait for you to discover!

Different types of Level-up options and a Unique Deterministic Re-Roll Mechanic.
The Future of Symphorix: Our Post-Launch Roadmap[p align="start"]As we've said, 1.0 is just the beginning. We have a packed roadmap for the year ahead, including:

New Attack Types: Prepare to wield the power of Shields and Lightning!

More Enemy Variety: We're designing tons of new enemies to challenge your strategies.

New Game Modes: Explore different ways to play with Meditative, Bullet Hell, Strategic, Endless, and a full Campaign mode.

And much more!
[p align="start"]Thank you once again for being a part of our Early Access journey. Your passion has fine-tuned Symphorix into something we are immensely proud of. We cannot wait for you to experience the full symphony of destruction in Version 1.0 later this month. Stay tuned for the official release date!
[p align="start"]With heartfelt gratitude,
[p align="start"]The OnTriggerJoy Team

notes.title: Update 0.91
notes.notes:
#\[0.91.0] - 2025-01-12#New Features
Find Your Perfect Track Faster: New song filters let you slice and dice the music library like a DJ ninja.

Type to search by song name, artist, album, description, or filename

Flip the Instrumental switch to see only instrumental tracks

Pick a Main Bonus (like Damage) to show only songs that grant that bonus

Dial in Bass/Mid/Treble synergies to match your build – choose one or stack all three

Use "ANY" to keep things flexible; combine filters for laser-precise results

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45405427/29ded18cb6b4a0114b4471f04dd71f9a09dc4e54.png"]

Keyboard Hints That Pop: A clean, icon-first controls guide now lives in the UI.

See keys as icons (W A S D, Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V, Left/Right Click, MouseWheel)

Short labels only: Copy, Cut, Paste, Move, SlowMo, Zoom In/Out

Colors adapt to your song palette so it always looks on-brand

Extra Thrust Effects: Your thruster now supports a secondary particle system for even more visual flair!

Add a second particle effect that automatically follows your thruster's movement and rotation

The secondary effect turns on when you move and off when you stop - perfect for emphasizing the path you took weaving in and out between enemies

Colors match your current song theme for that cohesive look

notes.title: V 0.90.0 Update: Coin Clarity, Power-Packed Components, and Smart Orbitals
notes.notes:
Game Update NotesNew FeaturesInfinite Builds Building
Node activation: First 3 nodes free. Additional nodes cost coins, increasing per node.

Behaviors: First behavior free, second costs coins, third and beyond double in cost.

Notes: First note free, subsequent notes increase cost by 25% each.

Beats: First beat free, second costs 25 coins, third and beyond double in cost.

Costs adjustable server-side for balance.

Cannot select nodes if activation cost exceeds available coins.

Config Costs display shows total cost: pay if positive, refund if negative.

Accept button locks in build and processes payment or refund.
Pay-What-You-Boost
Boosting stats costs coins (Full Refundable), increasing per boost on the same node.

Clear cost display replaces earnings penalties.
Supercharged Components
Boost multiple stats on a single component (e.g., damage and Homing Power).

Each stat has independent boost levels (1X, 2X, 3X).

Boosted stats saved with presets.

UI displays all boosted stats clearly.
Orbital Drones
Smooth rotation toward enemies instead of snapping.

New Orbital Speed stat controls drone turn speed.

Faster rotation tracks enemies better; slower rotation looks cinematic.

Drones feel responsive and lifelike.
Camera Controls
Smoother zoom functionality now in UI as well (Mouse Wheel).

Improved UI interaction for zooming.

More responsive camera behavior.
ImprovementsDirect Building
No upgrade caps; add features directly to nodes.

Free Flight toggle with clear coin cost.

Nodes-used display simplified to show active count.
Cost Display
Colors indicate status: red for paying, green for refunds, gray for neutral.

Next boost cost shown in red; removing last boost shows refund in green.

Session start requires accepting costs.
Boost Menu
Non-upgradeable stats (e.g., Enable Free Fly) excluded from boost list.
Component Management
Overhauled interface with clear boosted stat display.

Dynamic updates for boost level changes.

Improved visual feedback for boosted stats.

Presets save all stat boosts accurately.
Orbital Behavior
Smoother, more predictable drone targeting.

Fluid free-flying movement.
Stat Icons
Attack-type icons glow green when relevant to the selected node.

Updates instantly in stat panel, boosted stats list, song synergy, and song bonus.

Reflects changes when switching songs, components, or deselecting.
Fixed Issues
Resetting nodes updates Config Costs correctly for refunds.

Fixed rare cost text error.

Deselecting resets behavior icon colors instantly.

Song and component selection updates synergy and bonus icons immediately.

notes.title: V 0.26 Biggest update yet, DEMO also updated
notes.notes:
🎮 [0.26.0] - 2024-06-25 Musical Mayhem Update

🆕 New Features

🎼 Musical Enemies Crescendo
We've revamped how enemies appear throughout your battle!

Now enemies make a proper entrance - each musical note's enemies will be introduced with a stylish announcement when they join the battle

Start with just one enemy type and gradually meet the whole orchestra as difficulty increases

No more facing the entire enemy band from the get-go - you'll have time to learn each enemy's style before meeting the next one

The progression is tied to each song, so you'll always get the same enemy sequence for your favorite tracks

Consider it enemy matchmaking based on your musical taste!

🎯 Precision Kinetic System
Master your energy with surgical precision!

Bursts now ONLY fire when YOU choose - either by manual click or smart auto-fire

Auto-bursts trigger automatically when your energy battery fills during sustained fire

All bursts now laser-target your mouse cursor for pixel-perfect aiming

Continuous fire maintains pressure while building up to devastating full-battery bursts

No more surprise discharges - complete control over your firepower

🌈 Improvements

🎨 Song Color Makeover
We've completely revamped how colors are generated from your music!

Colors are now much more varied and unique for each song

No more getting similar colors for different songs

Smarter color selection ensures UI elements stay clear and readable

Even if a song can't be loaded properly, you'll still get consistent colors based on the filename

Say goodbye to those confusing moments when song colors looked too similar to red/green UI indicators

Your game's color palette will now perfectly complement your musical selections without interfering with gameplay clarity

🌈 Technicolor Projectiles
Enemy projectiles just got a fabulous makeover!

Projectiles now match the color of the enemy that fired them

No more boring white projectiles - now they're as colorful as the enemies themselves

This makes it easier to tell who's shooting at you in the heat of battle

Plus, enemy colors are now more vibrant and eye-catching with maximum saturation

It's like your enemies went shopping for neon paint - and they're not afraid to use it!

🎲 Shapeshifting Hitboxes
Enemies now feel more "real" than ever before!

Enemy hitboxes now perfectly match their visual appearance

Those spiky protrusions? Yep, they'll actually hit you now

No more frustrating moments where you thought you dodged but got hit anyway

Ultra-smooth organic contours instead of blocky angular shapes

The collision feels much more natural and precise

It's like the enemies just got an upgrade to their physical presence in the game world!

🔄 Complete Enemy Spawning Overhaul
We're rebuilding our enemy spawning system from the ground up!

The old music-based enemy spawning system is being replaced with something more exciting

This will give us greater control over enemy progression and difficulty scaling

Expect more interesting enemy patterns and choreographed encounters in future updates

The new system will tie more deeply into game progression and difficulty curves

Stay tuned for more details as we complete this major upgrade!

🖥️ Cleaned Up Game HUD
We've streamlined your in-game display to focus only on what you need most!

Removed all the enemy spawner clutter and boss-related UI elements

Simplified the screen to show just your kinetic energy, time dilation info, level, and heart crystals

No more distracting health and energy sliders taking up your precious screen space

Enjoy a cleaner, more focused view that lets you concentrate on the action

Your game performance might even be a tiny bit better with less UI to render

👾 Enemy Visual System Rework
Behind the scenes, we've completely overhauled how enemies look and animate!

Removed the old sphere-based visual system for something much more exciting (stay tuned!)

Simplified enemy effects for better performance and clearer visual feedback

Paved the way for more dynamic and expressive enemy designs

Don't worry - your enemies will still explode in satisfying ways when defeated!

🌟 Visual Makeover for Your Core
We've given your Core's visual system a serious upgrade!

Each Core component now gets its own unique copy of materials - no more identity crises where one component's color changes affect others!

Added fancy new color controls so your Core components can express themselves with Primary and Secondary colors

Introduced a slick new Pulse effect that makes your Core briefly "flex" before returning to normal - perfect for those "did you see that?!" moments

Added Health visualization directly on your Core - now you can literally see how your Core is feeling!

All these visual bells and whistles work behind the scenes with no performance hit - your Core is now both prettier AND more efficient!

🧠 Smart Shapes System
Your Core components just got a memory upgrade!

Components now store their unique shape identity in memory without actually using it

This "shape memory" is saved for future use by enemy systems - your Core keeps its classic look for now

Each exhaust node still maintains its own consistent, direction-specific seed

This prepares for a future update where enemies will use your shape patterns

Behind the scenes, this makes your Core much smarter about how it manages appearance data

Core components and enemies can now decide independently whether to use stored shape patterns

🌊 Reduced Visual Effects
We've removed the rhythmic pulsing effects from the ground to make the game more accessible and comfortable for all players!

The ground no longer pulses in response to music beats

This change helps reduce potential motion sensitivity issues

Makes the gameplay experience more comfortable for everyone

⚡ Smart Kinetic Discharge
Your kinetic energy system just got smarter!

Automatic bursts now fire when your energy battery fills up during continuous attacks

Bursts now always fire toward your mouse cursor for precise aiming

Continuous fire and automatic bursts work together seamlessly - lay down suppressive fire while building up to big bursts!

🔋 Streamlined Energy Management
Removed automatic emergency braking discharges

Energy system now focuses purely on offensive capabilities

Visual clutter from old direction indicators removed

🏃 Enemy Visual Feedback
Enemies now properly face their movement direction, making their behavior more readable

🌀 Teleportation Effects
Teleporting enemies now show distinct particle effects at both departure and arrival locations

🐛 Fixed Issues

🚫 No More Double Notifications
Fixed an annoying bug where cutting component settings would show you two popup messages - one for cutting and another for copying. Now we'll only bother you once when you cut, just as nature intended!

🕵️ Preset Detective
Your presets "heavy missile", "heavy sniper", "broodmother", and "my child" had gone into hiding, but we've tracked them down! They will now load properly when selected, no more "failed to load" messages getting in the way of your musical mayhem.

⏰ Time-Traveling Presets
Found some of your old presets containing stats from previous versions causing errors? We've taught the preset system to be more adaptable! It will now safely ignore any outdated stats while still applying everything else, ensuring your favorite configurations can stand the test of time.

🔤 Case-Insensitive Genius
Our preset system has become more forgiving about capitalization in stat names. It no longer cares if you wrote "FreeFlightPower" or "freeflightpower" - it'll figure it out! Your presets will load much more reliably no matter how they were saved.

🎬 Start Session Fix
Fixed a bug where the "Start Session" button would stay stubbornly off after you reset everything, even if the session was free. Now it correctly realizes when you can start playing!

🎯 Directional Hint TLC
Removed the confusing kinetic discharge direction indicator since bursts now always follow your mouse cursor. No more mixed signals about where your firepower is headed!

🌈 Teleportation Effect Cleanup
Fixed teleportation effects appearing three times instead of two (departure/arrival)

notes.title: Version 0.18 Demo Updated
notes.notes:
Version 0.18.0: Leveling, Projectiles, and Streamlined Systems

This update focuses on adding a leveling system, improving projectiles, streamlining gameplay systems, and fixing various bugs.

Key Changes


    Automatic Leveling System Added:
    
        Your stats now increase automatically as you level up.
        Level progression is integrated into the core gameplay.
        The UI shows your current level and changes.
        Stats are recalculated when you level up.
    
    Gameplay System Improvements:
    
        The camera has been improved.
        The sound system has been updated for better performance.
        The event system (which handles in-game events) has been enhanced.
        Gameplay components have been optimized.
        The user interface has been updated.
    
    Projectile System Overhaul:
    
        Projectiles now use physics-based movement for more realistic interactions.
        Collisions between projectiles and other objects are now more accurate, including trigger-based detection.
        Projectiles can now damage each other.
        Projectiles may deflect based on damage.
        Projectile size can change based on its remaining energy.
        Projectiles now automatically interact with the environment in a more logical way.
        Collision responses, including push forces, have been improved.
        Explosion damage and push forces are calculated more accurately.
    
    Stat System Changes:
    
        Stats now scale automatically based on your level.
        Stat calculations have been improved to include level-based increases.
    
    Streamlined Cost System:
       
         Some features will have a free usage, now.
        The first time you use specific assignable abilities, they will be free.
        The cost display now shows which features have free uses.
        Redundant cost displays have been removed.
    
    Note Activation Changes:
    
        Notes now activate instantly without any delay.
    
     Stat Adjustments:
     
        Irrelevant stat modifications are now cleared when abilities are disabled.
    


Bug Fixes


    Fixed issues with how stat attributes were displayed.
    Improved the responsiveness of the controls.
    Fixed various audio-related bugs.
    Fixed the display of font sizes and text in the UI.
    Fixed an issue where the cost of certain features was calculated incorrectly (showing as 0 when it shouldn't).
    Fixed a bug where the first free use of certain abilities was not being handled correctly.
